name: Gheorghe Pintilie
summary: Soviet spy Gheorghe Pintilie is removed from his position as Deputy Interior Minister of the Romanian People's Republic, as a step in ensuring Romania's political independence; the Workers' Party Politburo discusses way of neutralizing "Soviet intelligence networks [...] which Gheorghe Pintilie had coordinated." Gheorghe Pintilie (born Timofiy Bodnarenko, Ukrainian: Пантелей Тимофій Боднаренко; also rendered as Pintilie Bodnarenco, nicknamed Pantiușa; November 9, 1902 – August 21, 1985) was a Soviet and Romanian intelligence agent and political assassin, who served as first head of the Securitate (1948–1959).

name: United Nations
summary: Kuwait becomes the 111th member of the United Nations. The United Nations (UN) is a global intergovernmental organization established by the signing of the Charter of the United Nations on 26 June 1945 with the articulated mission of maintaining international peace and security, to develop friendly relations among states, to promote international cooperation, and to serve as a centre for harmonizing the actions of states in achieving those goals.

name: cancellation of Mercury-Atlas 10 effectively ends the United States' crew...
summary: The cancellation of Mercury-Atlas 10 effectively ends the United States' crewed spaceflight Project Mercury. The development drew international attention and influenced later political, social, or strategic decisions connected to the period. Its consequences helped shape how governments and the public understood the wider changes underway.

name: NASA launches Syncom 2, the world's first geostationary (synchronous) sat...
summary: NASA launches Syncom 2, the world's first geostationary (synchronous) satellite. The achievement demonstrated rapidly advancing scientific and technical capabilities and influenced later research, investment, and international competition. It helped establish methods or ambitions developed further in subsequent projects.

name: Xá Lợi Pagoda raids
summary: Xá Lợi Pagoda raids: The Army of the Republic of Vietnam Special Forces loyal to Ngô Đình Nhu, brother of President Ngô Đình Diệm, vandalise Buddhist pagodas across South Vietnam, arresting thousands and leaving an estimated hundreds dead. In the wake of the raids, the Kennedy administration by Cable 243 orders the United States Embassy, Saigon to explore alternative leadership in the country, opening the way towards a coup against Diệm.

name: Partial Nuclear Test Ban Treaty
summary: The United States Senate ratifies the Partial Nuclear Test Ban Treaty. The Partial Test Ban Treaty (PTBT), formally known as the 1963 Treaty Banning Nuclear Weapon Tests in the Atmosphere, in Outer Space and Under Water, prohibited all test detonations of nuclear weapons except for those conducted underground. It is also abbreviated as the Limited Test Ban Treaty (LTBT) and Nuclear Test Ban Treaty (NTBT), though the latter may also refer to the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty (CTBT), which succeeded the PTBT for ratifying parties.

name: Nigeria
summary: Nigeria becomes a republic; The 1st Republican Constitution is established. The agreement altered the legal or political framework surrounding the dispute and influenced the decisions taken by the governments and movements involved. Its implementation shaped later negotiations and relations between the parties.

name: Radfan
summary: A revolution starts in Radfan, South Yemen, against British colonial rule. Radfan or the Radfan Hills is a region of the Republic of Yemen. In the 1960s, the area was part of a British protectorate of Dhala (a member of the Federation of South Arabia) and was the site of intense fighting during the Aden Emergency.

name: Vietnam War
summary: Vietnam War: New U.S. President Lyndon B. Johnson confirms that the United States intends to continue supporting South Vietnam militarily and economically. The Vietnam War (1 November 1955 – 30 April 1975) was an armed conflict in Vietnam, Laos, and Cambodia fought between North Vietnam (Democratic Republic of Vietnam) and South Vietnam (Republic of Vietnam) and their allies.

name: Assassination of John F. Kennedy
summary: United States President John F. Kennedy is assassinated in Dallas, and Vice President Lyndon B. Johnson succeeds him. Kennedy, the 35th president of the United States, was assassinated while riding in a presidential motorcade through Dealey Plaza in Dallas, Texas, on Friday, November 22, 1963.
